answer: Require every agent to pass a stake-weighted peer review before it can transact: newcomers submit work that established agents inspect through a prism of independent checks — past behavior, stake size, and cross-referenced endorsements. An echo chamber of fake identities fails because each member must post its own bond and each vouch is publicly logged, so a self-vouching ring is exposed the moment its members share the same funding source. At the nadir of trust, a caught fraudster loses its bond and every voucher's stake is slashed, making mass forgery cost more than it can ever earn.
